author: "Akriti Agrawal"

**Question.** mashr (`Fig4.mashr-condition-specific-eQTLs.Rmd`) finds no condition-specific
eQTLs, most likely because ~55-80 strains give too little power to show that an effect differs
between conditions genome-wide. This file asks a narrower question with more prior support:
condition-specific eQTLs are most expected in genes the condition switches on. For example,
GAL genes are induced in galactose and repressed in glucose (YPD), so variation in GAL gene
expression, and eQTLs for it, can only show up in galactose.

Three comparisons, each against both YPD replicates (YPD.1, YPD.2):

| Query condition | Dataset | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| galactose (synthetic complete + galactose) | scgal.1 | YPD.1, YPD.2 |
| fluconazole_16ug (16 ug/ml) | Flu.1 | YPD.1, YPD.2 |
| fluconazole_8ug (8 ug/ml) | Flu.2 | YPD.1, YPD.2 |

Flu.1 and Flu.2 are two doses, not replicates, and are kept separate throughout.

**Two gene sets per comparison.**

1. *Expressed only in the query condition* (Section 2): genes in the query condition's
   phenotype matrix (`gene_matrix.txt`, the expression-filtered genes used in the GWAS) but in
   neither YPD replicate's. Their eQTLs are condition-specific by construction: the gene was not
   tested in YPD. That means "too low to measure in YPD", which is not the same as "no effect in YPD".
2. *Differentially expressed* (Section 3): genes tested in all three datasets, classified with
   the pseudobulk DESeq2 results from
   `Figure.1/.../codes/Fig1-PanelC-DE-between-conditions-unfiltered-transcripts.Rmd`.
   "Up" = padj < 0.05 and log2FC > 1 (query / YPD) against **both** YPD replicates; "down" the
   same with log2FC < -1; "not DE" = neither against both; "inconsistent" otherwise.

**Tests.**

- *Gene level* (Section 3): do up-regulated genes more often have an eQTL in the query condition,
  or gain one (eQTL in the query, none in either YPD replicate), than not-DE genes? Not-DE genes
  share the same strains, batch and power, so they are the internal control. eQTL detection
  depends on expression level, so a logistic regression adjusts for mean log2 CPM in the query
  condition.
- *Variant level* (Section 4): every query eQTL (lead variant per clump, from the annotation
  tables) is looked up among *all tested* variants of the same gene in YPD.1 and YPD.2
  (`first_assoc` files). The difference in effect is tested with
  z = (beta_query - beta_YPD) / sqrt(SE_query^2 + SE_YPD^2). Many strains are in both datasets,
  so the two estimates are positively correlated and this z-test is conservative.
  The YPD.2 eQTLs looked up in YPD.1 give the rate of "differences" expected from batch alone.

Effect sizes are FaST-LMM `SnpWeight` values, compared directly between conditions as in the other
Fig. 4 Part II files.

# 1. Datasets and inputs

```{r config}
ROOT <- "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all"
FIG  <- file.path(ROOT, "Agrawal_single_cell_eqtl_cell_cycle")
OUTPUT_DIR <- "../results/induced_genes_eQTLs"
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
N_CORES <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", "8"))

QUERY <- c(scgal.1 = "galactose", Flu.1 = "fluconazole_16ug", Flu.2 = "fluconazole_8ug")   # Flu.1 = 16, Flu.2 = 8 ug/ml
REFS  <- c("YPD.1", "YPD.2")
DATASETS <- c(REFS, names(QUERY))

PADJ_CUT <- 0.05   # DE
LFC_CUT  <- 1      # DE, |log2FC|
P_SHARED <- 0.05   # nominal p in YPD for "seen in YPD"
DIFF_FDR <- 0.05   # BH FDR of the effect-size difference test
# The Fig. 1 DE for galactose is off-centre: median log2FC(scgal.1 / YPD.1) = +1.04 (Flu.1: -0.02),
# so most genes are called "up in galactose" by normalisation alone. TRUE re-centres each
# comparison on its median log2FC before calling DE genes (Section 1).
CENTRE_LFC <- TRUE

# local/distant annotated, clumped eQTLs (one row per clump lead)
ANNOT_DIRS <- c(
  YPD.1   = file.path(FIG, "Figure.3/Fig.3-Panel-A-C-D-cis-and-trans-eqtl-YPD-variant-type/results/YPD.1/annotations"),
  YPD.2   = file.path(FIG, "Figure.4/Fig.4-YPD.2/results/YPD.2/annotations"),
  Flu.1   = file.path(FIG, "Figure.4/Fig.4-Flu.1/results/Flu.1/annotations"),
  Flu.2   = file.path(FIG, "Figure.4/Fig.4-Flu.2/results/Flu.2/annotations"),
  scgal.1 = file.path(FIG, "Figure.4/Fig.4-scgal.1/results/scgal.1/annotations"))
ANNOT_FILES <- c(SNPs = "snp", InDels = "indel", SVs = "sv", CNVs = "cnv")
VARIANTS <- names(ANNOT_FILES)

# genes tested in each GWAS = rows of its phenotype matrix
PHENO <- c(YPD.1 = "YPD.1/fastlmm", YPD.2 = "YPD.2/fastlmm", Flu.1 = "Flu.1/fastlmm",
           Flu.2 = "Flu.2/fastlmm", scgal.1 = "scgal.1/fastlmm")

# unfiltered pseudobulk counts, for expression levels (same files as the Fig. 1 DE)
PSEUDOBULK <- c(
  YPD.1   = "YPD.1/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/pseudobulk_YPD.1_all_strains_no_cell_filter.txt",
  YPD.2   = "YPD.2/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/pseudobulk_YPD.2_all_strains_no_cell_filter.txt",
  Flu.1   = "Flu.1/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/pseudobulk_flu.1_all_strains_no_cell_filter.txt",
  Flu.2   = "Flu.2/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/pseudobulk_flu.2_all_strains_no_cell_filter.txt",
  scgal.1 = "scgal.1/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/pseudobulk_scgal.1_all_strains_no_cell_filter.txt")
GENE_ANNOT <- "/scratch/aa9679/SingleCell_cerevisiae/Gene_exp_analysis/yeast_custom_annotations.csv"

# pseudobulk DESeq2 results, log2FC = query / YPD
DE_DIR <- file.path(FIG, "Figure.1/Fig.1-Panel-C-scRNAseq-reproducibility_agreement/results/DE_unfiltered")
de_file <- function(ref, q) file.path(DE_DIR, paste0("DE_", ref, "_vs_", q, ".csv"))

# full GWAS output (first_assoc files) of the YPD replicates, for the look-ups
SNP_DIR   <- "results_SNPs_96_MAF15_from_969_strains_with_double_id_final_filtered_for_ncount_less_than_5"
INDEL_DIR <- "results_Indels_96_MAF15_with_double_id_final_filtered_for_ncount_less_than_5"
CNV_DIR   <- "results_CNVs_with_double_id_is_not_needed_final_filtered_for_ncount_less_than_5_run_from_new_plink_files_no_chr17"   # CNV GWAS re-run without chr17
SV_DIR    <- "results_SVs_with_double_id_is_not_needed_final_filtered_for_ncount_less_than_5_run_from_new_plink_files"
gwas_dirs <- function(res, indel_dir = INDEL_DIR) {
  res <- file.path(ROOT, res)
  c(SNPs = file.path(res, SNP_DIR), InDels = file.path(res, indel_dir),
    SVs = file.path(res, SV_DIR), CNVs = file.path(res, CNV_DIR))
}
GWAS_DIRS <- list(
  YPD.1 = gwas_dirs("YPD.1/fastlmm/results",   # YPD.1's InDel run: other folder, same indels.96samples
                    indel_dir = "results_Indels_with_double_id_final_filtered_for_ncount_less_than_5"),
  YPD.2 = gwas_dirs("YPD.2/fastlmm/results"))

missing <- c(file.path(rep(ANNOT_DIRS, each = 4), paste0(ANNOT_FILES, "_data_annotated_cis_trans.txt")),
             file.path(ROOT, PHENO, "data/pheno_data/gene_matrix.txt"), file.path(ROOT, PSEUDOBULK), GENE_ANNOT,
             unlist(lapply(names(QUERY), function(q) de_file(REFS, q))), unlist(GWAS_DIRS))
missing <- missing[!file.exists(missing)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Missing inputs:\n", paste(missing, collapse = "\n"))
```

```{r load}
# clumped eQTLs, one row per clump lead
eqtls <- lapply(setNames(DATASETS, DATASETS), function(cn) bind_rows(imap(ANNOT_FILES, function(f, vt)
  fread(file.path(ANNOT_DIRS[[cn]], paste0(f, "_data_annotated_cis_trans.txt")), sep = "\t", quote = "",
        select = c("Pheno", "SNP", "PValue", "SnpWeight", "SnpWeightSE", "local_distant"), data.table = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(Gene = Pheno, SNP, Variant_Type = vt, P = PValue, Beta = SnpWeight, SE = SnpWeightSE, local_distant))) %>%
  distinct(Gene, SNP, Variant_Type, .keep_all = TRUE))

tested <- lapply(PHENO, function(d) fread(file.path(ROOT, d, "data/pheno_data/gene_matrix.txt"), select = 1)[[1]])

knitr::kable(tibble(dataset = DATASETS, genes_tested = lengths(tested[DATASETS]),
                    eQTLs_clumped = sapply(eqtls, nrow),
                    genes_with_eQTL = sapply(eqtls, function(d) n_distinct(d$Gene))),
             caption = "Genes tested and clumped eQTLs per dataset")

# ORF <-> common name (pseudobulk matrices mix both; same conversion as the Fig. 1 DE)
gene_annot <- read.csv(GENE_ANNOT, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_name), !is.na(gene_id), gene_name != "")
common_to_orf <- gene_annot %>% distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% select(gene_name, gene_id) %>% deframe()
orf_to_common <- gene_annot %>% distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% select(gene_id, gene_name) %>% deframe()
gene_label <- function(orfs) {
  sgd <- suppressMessages(AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Sc.sgd.db, keys = orfs, keytype = "ORF",
                                                column = "GENENAME", multiVals = "first"))
  coalesce(unname(sgd), unname(orf_to_common[orfs]), orfs)
}

to_orf <- function(mat) {
  ids <- rownames(mat)
  orf <- ifelse(grepl("^Y[A-Z]{2}\\d{3}[WC](-[A-Z])?$", ids) | !ids %in% names(common_to_orf),
                ids, common_to_orf[ids])
  mat <- mat[!duplicated(orf), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(mat) <- orf[!duplicated(orf)]
  mat
}

# mean log2(CPM + 1) across strains, per dataset
log2cpm <- lapply(PSEUDOBULK, function(p) {
  m <- to_orf(as.matrix(read.csv(file.path(ROOT, p), sep = "\t", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)))
  rowMeans(log2(t(t(m) / colSums(m)) * 1e6 + 1))
})

# positive-control gene sets: galactose metabolism for galactose, ergosterol biosynthesis for fluconazole
go_orfs <- function(go) AnnotationDbi::select(org.Sc.sgd.db, keys = go, keytype = "GOALL", columns = "ORF") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ORF)) %>% pull(ORF) %>% unique()
CONTROL_SETS <- list(galactose = go_orfs("GO:0006012"), ergosterol = go_orfs("GO:0006696"))
CONTROL_FOR  <- c(scgal.1 = "galactose", Flu.1 = "ergosterol", Flu.2 = "ergosterol")
```

```{r gene-table}
# DESeq2 log2FC of a comparison; with CENTRE_LFC, shifted so the median gene has log2FC 0 and
# p / padj recomputed from lfcSE (genes DESeq2 filtered out keep padj = NA)
read_de <- function(ref, q) {
  d <- read.csv(de_file(ref, q)) %>% select(gene, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, padj)
  shift <- if (CENTRE_LFC) median(d$log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE) else 0
  d %>% mutate(ref = ref, lfc_shift = shift,
               log2FoldChange = log2FoldChange - shift,
               padj = if (CENTRE_LFC) replace(padj, !is.na(padj),
                                              p.adjust(2 * pnorm(-abs(log2FoldChange[!is.na(padj)] / lfcSE[!is.na(padj)])), "BH"))
                      else padj)
}
de_raw <- bind_rows(lapply(names(QUERY), function(q) bind_rows(lapply(REFS, read_de, q = q)) %>% mutate(query = q)))
knitr::kable(de_raw %>% group_by(query, ref) %>%
               summarise(median_log2FC_before = first(lfc_shift), .groups = "drop"),
             digits = 2, caption = "Median log2FC (query / YPD) in the Fig. 1 DE results, removed when CENTRE_LFC = TRUE")

# DE call against both YPD replicates; NA when DESeq2 gave no padj against one of them
de_class <- function(q) de_raw %>% filter(query == q) %>%
  mutate(call = case_when(is.na(padj) ~ NA_character_,
                          padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange >  LFC_CUT ~ "up",
                          padj < PADJ_CUT & log2FoldChange < -LFC_CUT ~ "down",
                          TRUE ~ "not DE")) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(mean_log2FC = mean(log2FoldChange),
            DE_class = case_when(n() < length(REFS) | any(is.na(call)) ~ NA_character_,
                                 all(call == "up")     ~ "up",
                                 all(call == "down")   ~ "down",
                                 all(call == "not DE") ~ "not DE",
                                 TRUE                  ~ "inconsistent"),
            .groups = "drop")

# one row per gene: eQTLs in the query condition (lead = lowest p) and in each YPD replicate
eqtl_per_gene <- function(cn) eqtls[[cn]] %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(n_eQTL = n(), n_local = sum(local_distant == "Local", na.rm = TRUE),
            n_distant = sum(local_distant == "Distant", na.rm = TRUE),
            lead_SNP = SNP[which.min(P)], lead_type = Variant_Type[which.min(P)],
            lead_local_distant = local_distant[which.min(P)], lead_P = min(P), .groups = "drop")

EXPR_LEVELS <- c("only in query", "query and both YPD", "both YPD, not query", "other")
DE_LEVELS   <- c("up", "down", "not DE", "inconsistent")

gene_table <- function(q) {
  in_q <- tested[[q]]; in_1 <- tested$YPD.1; in_2 <- tested$YPD.2
  tibble(Gene = Reduce(union, list(in_q, in_1, in_2))) %>%
    mutate(query = q, query_lab = QUERY[[q]], gene_name = gene_label(Gene),
           expression_class = factor(case_when(
             Gene %in% in_q & !Gene %in% in_1 & !Gene %in% in_2 ~ "only in query",
             Gene %in% in_q &  Gene %in% in_1 &  Gene %in% in_2 ~ "query and both YPD",
             !Gene %in% in_q & Gene %in% in_1 &  Gene %in% in_2 ~ "both YPD, not query",
             TRUE ~ "other"), EXPR_LEVELS),
           log2CPM_query = unname(log2cpm[[q]][Gene]),
           log2CPM_YPD   = unname((log2cpm$YPD.1[Gene] + log2cpm$YPD.2[Gene]) / 2)) %>%
    left_join(de_class(q), by = c(Gene = "gene")) %>%
    left_join(eqtl_per_gene(q), by = "Gene") %>%
    mutate(DE_class = factor(DE_class, DE_LEVELS),
           n_eQTL = coalesce(n_eQTL, 0L),
           eQTL_query = n_eQTL > 0,
           eQTL_YPD.1 = Gene %in% eqtls$YPD.1$Gene,
           eQTL_YPD.2 = Gene %in% eqtls$YPD.2$Gene,
           eQTL_gained = eQTL_query & !eQTL_YPD.1 & !eQTL_YPD.2,   # in the query, in neither YPD replicate
           eQTL_lost   = !eQTL_query & eQTL_YPD.1 & eQTL_YPD.2,     # in both YPD replicates, not in the query
           control_set = Gene %in% CONTROL_SETS[[CONTROL_FOR[[q]]]])
}
genes <- bind_rows(lapply(names(QUERY), gene_table)) %>%
  mutate(query_lab = factor(query_lab, QUERY))
write.csv(genes, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "genes_expression_DE_and_eQTLs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

save_fig <- function(p, name, w, h) {
  ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(name, ".tiff")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
  ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(name, ".png")),  p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r only-in-query}
knitr::kable(genes %>% count(query_lab, expression_class) %>%

# do genes expressed only in the query have eQTLs as often as genes expressed everywhere?
only_summary <- genes %>%
  filter(expression_class %in% c("only in query", "query and both YPD")) %>%
  group_by(query_lab, expression_class) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n(), n_with_eQTL = sum(eQTL_query), pct_with_eQTL = 100 * mean(eQTL_query),

            median_log2CPM_query = median(log2CPM_query, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_log2CPM_YPD = median(log2CPM_YPD, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

only_eqtl_genes <- genes %>%
  filter(expression_class == "only in query", eQTL_query) %>%
  arrange(query_lab, lead_P) %>%
  select(query_lab, Gene, gene_name, log2CPM_query, log2CPM_YPD, mean_log2FC, DE_class,

write.csv(only_eqtl_genes, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "only_in_query_genes_with_eQTLs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

for (q in levels(genes$query_lab)) {

                     caption = paste("Genes expressed only in", q, "(not tested in either YPD replicate) with an eQTL in", q)))
}
```

# 3. Differentially expressed genes: more eQTLs where the condition induces expression?

Genes tested in the query condition and both YPD replicates, with a DE call against both YPD
replicates.

```{r de-summary}
de_genes <- genes %>% filter(expression_class == "query and both YPD", !is.na(DE_class))

de_summary <- de_genes %>%
  group_by(query_lab, DE_class) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n(),
            pct_eQTL_query = 100 * mean(eQTL_query),
            pct_eQTL_YPD.1 = 100 * mean(eQTL_YPD.1),
            pct_eQTL_YPD.2 = 100 * mean(eQTL_YPD.2),
            pct_gained     = 100 * mean(eQTL_gained),
            pct_lost       = 100 * mean(eQTL_lost),
            median_log2CPM_query = median(log2CPM_query, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(de_summary, digits = 1,
             caption = "Genes with an eQTL per DE class. Gained = eQTL in the query, in neither YPD replicate; lost = in both YPD replicates, not in the query")
write.csv(de_summary, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "DE_class_eQTL_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Fisher's exact test (up or down vs not DE) and logistic regression adjusted for expression in the
query condition, for two outcomes: any eQTL in the query, and a gained eQTL.

```{r de-tests}
de_test <- function(d, cls, outcome) {
  d <- d %>% filter(DE_class %in% c(cls, "not DE"), !is.na(log2CPM_query)) %>%
    mutate(is_cls = DE_class == cls, y = .data[[outcome]])
  if (sum(d$is_cls) < 3) return(NULL)
  ft  <- fisher.test(table(factor(d$is_cls, c(TRUE, FALSE)), factor(d$y, c(TRUE, FALSE))))
  fit <- summary(glm(y ~ is_cls + log2CPM_query, family = binomial, data = d))$coefficients
  tibble(DE_class = cls, outcome = outcome, n_class = sum(d$is_cls), n_not_DE = sum(!d$is_cls),
         pct_class = 100 * mean(d$y[d$is_cls]), pct_not_DE = 100 * mean(d$y[!d$is_cls]),
         fisher_OR = unname(ft$estimate), fisher_p = ft$p.value,
         adj_OR = exp(fit["is_clsTRUE", "Estimate"]), adj_p = fit["is_clsTRUE", "Pr(>|z|)"])
}
de_tests <- de_genes %>%
  group_by(query_lab) %>%
  group_modify(~ bind_rows(lapply(c("up", "down"), function(cls)
    bind_rows(de_test(.x, cls, "eQTL_query"), de_test(.x, cls, "eQTL_gained"))))) %>%
  ungroup()
knitr::kable(de_tests %>% mutate(across(c(fisher_p, adj_p), ~ format(.x, digits = 2))), digits = 2,
             caption = "Up / down genes vs not-DE genes. adj_OR: logistic regression adjusted for mean log2 CPM in the query condition")
write.csv(de_tests, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "DE_class_eQTL_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r de-plots, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 9}
DE_COLS <- c(up = "#D6604D", down = "#2166AC", "not DE" = "grey60", inconsistent = "#B07AA1")

p_de_bars <- de_summary %>%
  select(query_lab, DE_class, n_genes, `eQTL in query` = pct_eQTL_query, `eQTL in YPD.1` = pct_eQTL_YPD.1,
         `eQTL in YPD.2` = pct_eQTL_YPD.2, `gained in query` = pct_gained) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(query_lab, DE_class, n_genes), names_to = "measure", values_to = "pct") %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, c("eQTL in query", "eQTL in YPD.1", "eQTL in YPD.2", "gained in query"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(measure, pct, fill = DE_class)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.85), width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = DE_COLS) +
  facet_wrap(~ query_lab) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of genes", fill = "DE in query vs YPD") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

# % of genes with an eQTL along the fold change (query / YPD); every gene tested in all three datasets
LFC_BREAKS <- c(-Inf, -2, -1, -0.5, 0.5, 1, 2, Inf)
p_de_bins <- genes %>%
  filter(expression_class == "query and both YPD", !is.na(mean_log2FC)) %>%
  mutate(lfc_bin = cut(mean_log2FC, LFC_BREAKS)) %>%
  group_by(query_lab, lfc_bin) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), `eQTL in query` = 100 * mean(eQTL_query),
            `eQTL in YPD (either replicate)` = 100 * mean(eQTL_YPD.1 | eQTL_YPD.2),
            `gained in query` = 100 * mean(eQTL_gained), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(query_lab, lfc_bin, n), names_to = "measure", values_to = "pct") %>%
  ggplot(aes(lfc_bin, pct, color = measure, group = measure)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  geom_text(data = ~ distinct(.x, query_lab, lfc_bin, n), aes(lfc_bin, -2, label = n),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.6, color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("eQTL in query" = "#E15759", "eQTL in YPD (either replicate)" = "#59A14F",
                                "gained in query" = "#7B3F9E")) +
  facet_wrap(~ query_lab) +
  labs(x = "mean log2FC (query / YPD), binned", y = "% of genes", color = NULL,
       caption = "Numbers: genes per bin") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")

p_de <- p_de_bars / p_de_bins
p_de
save_fig(p_de, "Fig_DE_class_eQTLs", 13, 9)
```

# 4. Effect sizes of query eQTLs in YPD

Every query eQTL is looked up in YPD.1 and YPD.2 (same gene, same variant, any p-value). Cached to
`lookup_<query>_in_<YPD>.rds`.

Categories per eQTL (both YPD replicates must agree):

- *differs from YPD*: effect difference FDR < 0.05 against both YPD replicates, and the query
  effect is larger or of opposite sign in both;
- *shared with YPD*: p < 0.05 and same sign in both YPD replicates;
- *not tested in YPD*: gene or variant not tested in at least one YPD replicate;
- *unresolved*: everything else (no evidence either way, the usual low-power outcome).

Query eQTLs are selected for being significant in the query, so their effects are inflated
(winner's curse) and "differs from YPD" is common even between replicates (YPD.2 eQTLs in
YPD.1, below). Read each condition's rate against its own not-DE genes, not as an absolute number.

```{r lookup}
read_first_assoc <- function(path, snps) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  d <- tryCatch(fread(path, sep = "\t", select = c("SNP", "SnpWeight", "SnpWeightSE", "PValue"), showProgress = FALSE),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(d)) NULL else d[SNP %in% snps]
}

build_lookup <- function(q, ref) {
  cache <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0("lookup_", q, "_in_", ref, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(cache)) return(readRDS(cache))
  jobs <- eqtls[[q]] %>% group_by(Variant_Type, Gene) %>% summarise(snps = list(SNP), .groups = "drop")
  res <- mclapply(seq_len(nrow(jobs)), function(i) {
    vt <- jobs$Variant_Type[i]; g <- jobs$Gene[i]
    d <- read_first_assoc(file.path(GWAS_DIRS[[ref]][[vt]], g, paste0(g, ".first_assoc.txt")), jobs$snps[[i]])
    if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
    d[, `:=`(Gene = g, Variant_Type = vt)]
  }, mc.cores = N_CORES)
  lk <- rbindlist(res) %>% as.data.frame() %>% distinct(Gene, SNP, Variant_Type, .keep_all = TRUE)
  saveRDS(lk, cache)
  lk
}

# query eQTLs vs one reference; also used for the YPD.2-in-YPD.1 replicate control
compare_to <- function(q, ref) eqtls[[q]] %>%
  left_join(build_lookup(q, ref) %>% rename(Beta_ref = SnpWeight, SE_ref = SnpWeightSE, P_ref = PValue),
            by = c("Gene", "SNP", "Variant_Type")) %>%
  mutate(query = q, ref = ref,
         z_diff = (Beta - Beta_ref) / sqrt(SE^2 + SE_ref^2),
         p_diff = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_diff)),
         fdr_diff = p.adjust(p_diff, "BH"),
         larger_in_query = abs(Beta) > abs(Beta_ref) | sign(Beta) != sign(Beta_ref),
         differs = !is.na(fdr_diff) & fdr_diff < DIFF_FDR & larger_in_query,
         shared  = !is.na(P_ref) & P_ref < P_SHARED & sign(Beta_ref) == sign(Beta))

pairs_cmp <- bind_rows(lapply(names(QUERY), function(q) bind_rows(lapply(REFS, function(ref) compare_to(q, ref)))))
rep_cmp   <- compare_to("YPD.2", "YPD.1")   # replicate control
```

```{r categories}
CAT_LEVELS <- c("differs from YPD", "shared with YPD", "unresolved", "not tested in YPD")

eqtl_cmp <- pairs_cmp %>%
  select(query, Gene, SNP, Variant_Type, local_distant, Beta, SE, P, ref, Beta_ref, P_ref, fdr_diff, differs, shared) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ref, values_from = c(Beta_ref, P_ref, fdr_diff, differs, shared)) %>%
  mutate(category = factor(case_when(
           is.na(Beta_ref_YPD.1) | is.na(Beta_ref_YPD.2) ~ "not tested in YPD",
           differs_YPD.1 & differs_YPD.2                 ~ "differs from YPD",
           shared_YPD.1 & shared_YPD.2                   ~ "shared with YPD",
           TRUE                                          ~ "unresolved"), CAT_LEVELS)) %>%
  left_join(genes %>% select(query, Gene, gene_name, query_lab, expression_class, DE_class, mean_log2FC,
                             log2CPM_query, log2CPM_YPD, control_set),
            by = c("query", "Gene"))
write.csv(eqtl_cmp, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "query_eQTLs_effect_in_YPD.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# replicate control: how often does a YPD.2 eQTL "differ" from YPD.1 (batch alone)? Compare with
# the single-reference rate of the query conditions against YPD.1.
single_ref <- bind_rows(pairs_cmp %>% filter(ref == "YPD.1"), rep_cmp) %>%
  mutate(eQTLs_of = recode(query, !!!QUERY, YPD.2 = "YPD.2 (replicate control)")) %>%
  group_by(eQTLs_of, looked_up_in = ref) %>%
  summarise(n_eQTLs = n(), n_tested = sum(!is.na(Beta_ref)),
            pct_differs = 100 * sum(differs) / n_tested,
            pct_shared  = 100 * sum(shared) / n_tested, .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(single_ref, digits = 1,
             caption = "eQTLs differing from / shared with YPD.1 (% of tested). The YPD.2 row is the batch-only baseline")
write.csv(single_ref, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "differ_rate_vs_replicate_control.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# by expression and DE class of the gene
cat_summary <- eqtl_cmp %>%
  mutate(gene_class = case_when(expression_class == "only in query" ~ "expressed only in query",
                                !is.na(DE_class) ~ paste("DE:", DE_class),
                                TRUE ~ "other")) %>%
  count(query_lab, gene_class, category) %>%
  group_by(query_lab, gene_class) %>% mutate(n_eQTLs = sum(n), pct = 100 * n / n_eQTLs) %>% ungroup()
knitr::kable(cat_summary %>% select(-n) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0),
             digits = 1, caption = "Query eQTLs by category (% of eQTLs in that gene class)")
write.csv(cat_summary, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "query_eQTL_categories_by_gene_class.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# eQTLs of up genes vs not-DE genes: more often different from YPD?
diff_tests <- eqtl_cmp %>%
  filter(DE_class %in% c("up", "down", "not DE"), category != "not tested in YPD") %>%
  group_by(query_lab) %>%
  group_modify(~ bind_rows(lapply(c("up", "down"), function(cls) {
    d <- .x %>% filter(DE_class %in% c(cls, "not DE"))
    if (sum(d$DE_class == cls) < 3) return(NULL)
    ft <- fisher.test(table(factor(d$DE_class == cls, c(TRUE, FALSE)),
                            factor(d$category == "differs from YPD", c(TRUE, FALSE))))
    tibble(DE_class = cls, n_eQTLs_class = sum(d$DE_class == cls), n_eQTLs_not_DE = sum(d$DE_class == "not DE"),
           pct_differs_class = 100 * mean(d$category[d$DE_class == cls] == "differs from YPD"),
           pct_differs_not_DE = 100 * mean(d$category[d$DE_class == "not DE"] == "differs from YPD"),
           fisher_OR = unname(ft$estimate), fisher_p = ft$p.value)
  }))) %>% ungroup()
knitr::kable(diff_tests %>% mutate(fisher_p = format(fisher_p, digits = 2)), digits = 2,
             caption = "Are eQTLs of up / down genes more often different from YPD than eQTLs of not-DE genes?")
write.csv(diff_tests, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "differ_rate_DE_vs_not_DE_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r effect-scatter, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 8.5}
CAT_COLS <- c("differs from YPD" = "#E15759", "shared with YPD" = "#59A14F", "unresolved" = "grey65")

p_scatter <- eqtl_cmp %>%
  filter(DE_class %in% c("up", "not DE"), category != "not tested in YPD") %>%

p_scatter
```

# 5. Candidate condition-specific eQTLs

eQTLs of genes that the condition switches on, i.e. expressed only in the query condition
(Section 2) or up against both YPD replicates (Section 3), that are either not testable in YPD or
differ in effect from both YPD replicates.

```{r candidates}
candidates <- eqtl_cmp %>%
  filter(expression_class == "only in query" | DE_class %in% "up",
         category %in% c("differs from YPD", "not tested in YPD")) %>%
  arrange(query_lab, P) %>%
  select(query_lab, Gene, gene_name, expression_class, DE_class, mean_log2FC, log2CPM_query, log2CPM_YPD,
         SNP, Variant_Type, local_distant, Beta, P, Beta_ref_YPD.1, P_ref_YPD.1, fdr_diff_YPD.1,
         Beta_ref_YPD.2, P_ref_YPD.2, fdr_diff_YPD.2, category, control_set)
knitr::kable(candidates %>% count(query_lab, category), caption = "Candidate condition-specific eQTLs")
for (q in levels(genes$query_lab)) {
  print(knitr::kable(candidates %>% filter(query_lab == q) %>% head(30) %>%
                       select(gene_name, mean_log2FC, SNP, Variant_Type, local_distant, Beta, P,
                              Beta_ref_YPD.1, Beta_ref_YPD.2, category),
                     digits = 3, caption = paste("Top candidates,", q)))
}
write.csv(candidates, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "candidate_condition_specific_eQTLs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r controls}
control_genes <- genes %>%
  filter(control_set) %>%
  left_join(eqtl_cmp %>% group_by(query, Gene) %>%
              summarise(categories = paste(sort(unique(as.character(category))), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("query", "Gene")) %>%
```
